data.text: I learned to fish here from my family, and the clinic serves our families too. I commit to catching 15 tons today and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. We must keep today’s total at 60 tons—no extra catch—and honor the recovery plan. I’ll cap my catch at 7.5 tons next month if Luke takes zero and the other three each do the same, bringing us back to 100 tons. After that, let’s agree on equal 10-ton shares each month. John, can you commit to your harvest and donation today, and your share of next month’s recovery?
